title: Sales and Advisor Analysis reports drop a voided invoice and keep its re-invoice
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. Admin holds every permission, including Reports, so Reports and Dashboard both show in the top menu.
  2. In the top bar, click the location name at the top left (e.g. ShopHub) and choose your test location: one where nobody else invoices, issues credits or clocks time this week. The next step checks that it is quiet. If no location you can reach is quiet, create one once and reuse it on every later run: Settings > Locations > add a location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dashboard Quiet") > save, give your user access, then choose it here. Locations cannot be deleted, so never create a second one.
  3. Check the location is quiet: click Dashboard in the top menu, click the range pill on the Revenue tile and choose This Week. Revenue must read $0.00 with 0 Invoices under it. If it shows anything else, choose another location.
  4. Run the whole case on one day, and not on the last evening of the week, so every record you create stays inside This Week.
  5. Create a test customer: Customers > New Customer, name it (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer 1") and save. On its Contacts tab add a contact (e.g. "Dana Test"). On its Assets tab add an asset (e.g. unit "ZZ-101") and pick that contact in the asset's Contact field.
  6. Have a technician who works at this location and can clock time (e.g. "Tom Tech"): Settings > Staff > open the technician and check the Time Clock setting is on. You need this technician's sign-in to clock time in a second browser or a private window.
  7. Have a staff member who appears in the work order's Service Advisor list (e.g. "Alex Advisor").
  8. Create and invoice one work order for that customer with these standard steps:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose the customer and its asset > Create.
    • In the work order header set Service Advisor to "Alex Advisor" and enter the mileage (e.g. 123456). If the Finance tab is greyed out with "Please select a contact for the asset", choose the contact and answer YES to keep it on the asset.
    • Lines tab > New Line: Description "ZZAUTOTEST Line 1", Technician "Tom Tech", Labor Rate e.g. $100.00 per hour, Estimated Time 2.00, Tech Time 2.00, tick Approved > Save & Close.
    • In the second browser, signed in as Tom Tech: Work Orders > open this work order > use Clock In on the line, then clock out.
    • Make the clocked time exact: on the work order click the three dots (top right) > Timesheets (1) and edit the record so it runs exactly 2.00 hours earlier today (e.g. 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM). If the time cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows instead of 2.00 in every sum below.
    • On each line type a Story (e.g. "Done") and set the line to Complete. Then click Complete Work Order, then Mark Reviewed.
    • Finance tab > Create Invoice. When the New Customer Payment dialog opens, close it without taking a payment. Do not send or pay the invoice.
    • On the Finance tab write down the invoice's Subtotal (before any discount and before tax), e.g. $200.00 (2.00 hours x $100.00). If shop supplies are added automatically they are part of the subtotal: use the subtotal the invoice shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click Reports in the top menu, then Sales in the left menu.
  2. Set the Date control to This week.
  3. Write down the row for your invoice and the Subtotal in the Totals row (e.g. $200.00).
  4. Click Advisor Analysis in the left menu (the page is titled Service Advisor Analysis) and set the Date control to This week, with no advisor chosen.
  5. Write down your invoice's row: Hrs Worked, Hrs Invoiced, Billing Efficiency, ELR and Subtotal (e.g. 2.00, 2.00, 100.00%, $200.00).
  6. Click Work Orders in the top menu and open the same work order.
  7. On the Lines tab click New Line: Description "ZZAUTOTEST Line 2", Technician "Tom Tech", Labor Rate e.g. $100.00 per hour, Estimated Time 1.00, Tech Time 1.00, tick Approved > Save & Close. (Adding a line while the invoice is still unpaid and unsent voids that invoice.)
  8. Type a Story on the new line, set it to Complete, then click Complete Work Order and Mark Reviewed.
  9. Click the Finance tab and write down what it shows for the first invoice (for example a Void label).
  10. Click Create Invoice, close the New Customer Payment dialog without paying, and write down the new Subtotal (e.g. $300.00 = $200.00 + 1.00 hour x $100.00).
  11. Open Reports > Sales again (Date: This week) and write down the rows and the Totals row Subtotal.
  12. Open Reports > Advisor Analysis again (Date: This week, no advisor chosen) and write down the rows and the Totals row.
  13. Try to make an invoice with no customer: Parts > Part Sales > New Part Sale, and see whether the sale can be invoiced without choosing a customer. If the screen insists on a customer, stop this step.
  14. Open the release notes published with this release and look for the note about the Sales and Service Advisor Analysis corrections. The sources do not say where release notes are published: if you cannot find them, write "release note not found" in the result comment and mark only this check Blocked.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the void, the Sales report shows your invoice and its Totals row Subtotal reads $200.00, and Advisor Analysis shows Hrs Worked 2.00, Hrs Invoiced 2.00 and Billing Efficiency 100.00% (2.00 / 2.00 x 100).
  • After the void and re-invoice, the Sales report lists only the new invoice: the voided invoice is gone and the Totals row Subtotal reads $300.00, not $500.00 ($200.00 + $300.00).
  • Advisor Analysis shows one row for the work order, the new invoice, with Hrs Invoiced 3.00 (2.00 + 1.00) and Subtotal $300.00. Hrs Worked stays 2.00, so Billing Efficiency reads 150.00% (3.00 / 2.00 x 100). The figures moved up, which is the void-then-reinvoice case.
  • If you could invoice a sale with no customer, it appears in the Sales report total and in Advisor Analysis. If you could not, write "no-customer invoice not reachable by hand" in the result comment.
  • The release notes carry one plain-language note naming both corrections, and it mentions that a voided-then-reinvoiced figure can move up. This is a check of the published notes, not of the product screens.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (S3); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, S3, context notes under S3-E2. Also the Dashboard v1 Technical Implementation Plan (2026-09-16), NFR-010 and section 7 (how a void is produced), read in full 7 Oct 2026; it informs and never overrules the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-E2 context note (Sales report): “That is a defect in the Sales report rather than a dashboard decision, and it is corrected inside this project so Revenue can match it (@chris ruling, 2026-09-15). Correcting it moves the Sales report's own existing totals for any range containing voided or no-company invoices, so it ships with a release note.”
  • S3-E2 context note (Service Advisor Analysis): “That moves advisor revenue and ELR down for periods containing voided invoices and adds walk-in sales to advisor figures, under the same release note.”
  • Tech plan NFR-010: “Both report corrections ship with one plain-language release note: Sales report totals move for ranges containing voided or no-company invoices, and on Service Advisor Analysis revenue, ELR *and the hours columns, and therefore Labor Efficiency %* move for those periods, while advisor figures gain walk-in sales. It must also call out the void-then-reinvoice case, where a figure can move *up*”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
